item.title: security: Star Blizzard refines phishing and malware delivery with the RedFlick technique
item.description:
Microsoft says the Russian state threat actor Star Blizzard has improved detection evasion since January 2026 using large-scale phishing, compromised website accounts, and a new malware delivery method called RedFlick.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
